historical_references.reference: In Hindu mythology, Deepashree was the name of the daughter of King Vibhishana when he married Mandodari, sister of Ravana. She was a devoted wife and an ideal woman. She is often depicted as the embodiment of purity and devotion.

Another reference to Deepashree can be found in the Puranic literature where she is mentioned as the daughter of sage Vibhishana and Tara, sister of Valmiki. She is considered the goddess of inner light and knowledge.
